verdict.rationale: Docs mention that Dedicated Endpoints let customers 'deploy custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants' on reserved capacity, which supports the core ask of serving custom weights, but there is no mention of LoRA adapters specifically, no self-serve upload workflow, and dedicated endpoints appear to be a sales-gated enterprise offering rather than an ml-engineer self-service path. missing for 10: LoRA adapter support, a documented self-serve upload/deploy workflow, and independent confirmation that this works outside enterprise sales engagement.
